components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action: dark ink at rest, Vermilion Ink when lifted.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 19px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #171713); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink, #171713); color: var(--white, #fffdf7); font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--sans, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .04em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease, background .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); background: var(--red, #c9362b); border-color: var(--red, #c9362b); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--red-dark, #98261e); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #e7b72b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(0, 0); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: An outlined paper control with the same physical lift as the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 19px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #171713); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #171713); font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--sans, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .04em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease, background .16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); background: var(--white, #fffdf7); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink, #171713); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--red, #c9362b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translate(0, 0); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Tool Pill
components.description: A compact reader control that turns Berlin Blue when active.
components.css: .ds-tool-pill { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #c9c0b0); border-radius: 0; background: var(--white, #fffdf7); color: var(--muted, #6d685f); font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--sans, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool-pill:hover, .ds-tool-pill[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--blue, #275ba8); background: var(--blue, #275ba8); color: #fff; } .ds-tool-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #e7b72b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A square filtering control with a solid Vermilion selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #c9c0b0); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #f3efe5); color: var(--ink, #171713); font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--sans, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--red, #c9362b); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--red, #c9362b); background: var(--red, #c9362b); color: #fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #e7b72b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A plain Clean Sheet field bounded by a quiet printer's rule.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted, #6d685f); font: 800 10px/1.2 var(--sans, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-field input { padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #c9c0b0); border-radius: 0; background: var(--white, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #171713); font: 400 16px/1.55 var(--sans, sans-serif); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--red, #c9362b); outline: 2px solid var(--red, #c9362b); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #6d685f); }

components.name: Main Navigation
components.description: A ruled editorial header with a rotated Vermilion printer's mark.
components.html:
WWORT FÜR WORT
READPLAYCARDS
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 18px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #c9c0b0); background: var(--paper, #f3efe5); font-family: var(--sans, sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { color: var(--muted, #6d685f); text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--ink, #171713) !important; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-wordmark b { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--red, #c9362b); color: #fff; transform: rotate(-3deg); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; } .ds-nav > div { display: flex; gap: 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-nav > div a { padding-bottom: 3px; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-nav > div a:hover, .ds-nav > div .ds-current { color: var(--ink, #171713); border-color: var(--red, #c9362b); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #e7b72b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: A square editorial route card animated by one bold geometric ink form.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-path-card { position: relative; min-height: 280px; padding: 28px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #171713); background: rgba(255,253,247,.42); color: var(--ink, #171713); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--sans, sans-serif); transition: background .18s ease; } .ds-path-card:hover { background: var(--white, #fffdf7); } .ds-path-card i { position: absolute; right: -30px; top: 35px; width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--red, #c9362b); transition: transform .25s ease; } .ds-path-card:hover i { transform: rotate(12deg) scale(1.06); } .ds-path-label { position: relative; z-index: 1; color: var(--muted, #6d685f); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-path-card h3 { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin: auto 0 10px; font: 500 36px/1.05 var(--serif, Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-path-card p { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 34ch; margin: 0 0 24px; color: var(--muted, #6d685f); font: 400 16px/1.6 var(--sans, sans-serif); } .ds-path-card b { position: relative; z-index: 1; color: var(--red-dark, #98261e); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-path-card:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--yellow, #e7b72b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-popover { width: min(500px, 90vw); padding: 20px 22px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 12px 18px; align-items: center; border-top: 4px solid var(--yellow, #e7b72b); background: var(--ink, #171713); color: var(--white, #fffdf7); box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(32,28,20,.12); } .ds-popover strong { display: block; font: 500 36px/1.05 var(--serif, Georgia, serif); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-popover span { color: var(--line, #c9c0b0); font: 400 13px/1.45 var(--sans, sans-serif); } .ds-popover p { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; padding-top: 11px; border-top: 1px solid var(--muted, #6d685f); color: var(--paper-2, #e9e1d2); font: 500 13px/1.55 var(--sans, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .01em; } .ds-popover button { width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--muted, #6d685f); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-popover button:hover { border-color: var(--yellow, #e7b72b); color: var(--yellow, #e7b72b); } .ds-popover button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #e7b72b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Flashcard
components.description: A large Clean Sheet learning plate with a Berlin Blue structural offset.
components.css: .ds-flashcard { min-height: 300px; width: min(560px, 90vw); padding: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #171713); border-radius: 0; background: var(--white, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #171713); box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 var(--blue, #275ba8); text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-flashcard strong { font: 500 clamp(32px, 5vw, 54px)/1.05 var(--serif, Georgia, serif); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-flashcard span { color: var(--muted, #6d685f); font: 400 18px/1.5 var(--sans, sans-serif); } .ds-flashcard small { color: var(--muted, #6d685f); font: 800 11px/1.2 var(--sans, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-flashcard:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 12px 12px 0 var(--blue, #275ba8); } .ds-flashcard:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--red, #c9362b); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-flashcard:active { transform: translate(0, 0); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--blue, #275ba8); }

narrative.overview:
Wort für Wort should feel like entering a small Berlin print studio where a literary reader, a teaching poster, and a set of hand-operated study tools are being made at the same table. Paper warmth and old-style serif type create a scholarly reading atmosphere; hard rules, compact labels, and saturated blocks of ink keep it active rather than precious.

The system is tactile, editorial, energetic, and scholarly. It rejects glossy SaaS polish and cartoonish gamification: learning states are communicated through ink, geometry, weight, and physical movement rather than glass effects, inflated rounding, or ornamental reward systems.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper fields with near-black editorial structure.
Literary serif text paired with compact modernist sans-serif labels.
Saturated vermilion, blue, ochre, and green used as deliberate ink blocks.
Square, one-pixel-bordered surfaces with hard offset shadows.
Circles, squares, and triangles used as print-shop geometry, not decoration for its own sake.

rules.name: The Limited-Ink Rule
rules.body: Paper Cream and Printer's Black carry the page. Saturated colors appear in deliberate blocks or meaningful states; do not blend them into glossy gradients or scatter them as decoration.

rules.name: The Story-and-Workshop Rule
rules.body: Serif type carries language, narrative, and human-scale meaning. Sans-serif type operates the interface and labels the learning machinery; do not reverse those jobs casually.

rules.name: The Structural-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use crisp, zero-blur offsets for objects that feel printed, stacked, or pressed. Use blur only when a temporary overlay physically sits above the entire page.

dos: Do let Paper Cream and Printer's Black establish most of every screen.
Do use the serif for German words, stories, and expressive headings, and the sans-serif for controls and metadata.
Do use one-pixel rules, square corners, and crisp offset shadows to preserve the print-workshop construction.
Do reserve Vermilion, Blue, Ochre, and Green for clear hierarchy, information, selection, and learning states.
Do preserve generous reading line-height and focused 760–820px reading widths.
donts: Don't introduce glossy gradients, glassmorphism, inflated rounding, or soft SaaS-style card stacks.
Don't turn learning progress into cartoon rewards, decorative badges, or confetti.
Don't use saturated colors interchangeably; each ink has a specific semantic job.
Don't add ambient shadows to ordinary cards or controls; hard offsets are the default physical language.
Don't shrink dense mobile controls below comfortable tap targets or remove the reduced-motion behavior.
